name: Iron Dynamo
look: a pale lavender sphere of four blue-grey panels round a face of glowing yellow dots, with threaded drill cones on its sides and below, two floating three-fingered hands and a little spiked drone
entry: A Pokémon resembling Regieleki, pictured in a dubious magazine story about a machine that drilled for lightning. Its drills bore through rock as it charges, and its hands and its little drone fly off on their own to fetch what it digs up.
how: Wild: very rare in dripstone caves.
